text:
```yaml
name: Test

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@v5
      with:
        go-version: 'latest'

    - name: Run tests
      run: go test ./...
```
